description: A script for sentiment analysis of stock-related tweets, including Twitter API interaction, text cleaning, sentiment scoring, visualization, and streaming tweets.

classes.name: CustomStreamListener
classes.description: A custom Twitter stream listener class for streaming tweets with a time limit.

methods.name: get_symbol
methods.description: Fetches the company name for a given stock symbol using Yahoo Finance API.

methods.name: word_cloud
methods.description: Generates a word cloud visualization from a list of words.

methods.name: sentiment_analyzer_scores
methods.description: Calculates sentiment score of a text using VADER, with optional translation.

methods.name: list_tweets
methods.description: Retrieves latest tweets from a specified Twitter user.

methods.name: remove_pattern
methods.description: Removes regex pattern matches from a string.

methods.name: clean_tweets
methods.description: Cleans a list of tweets by removing handles, URLs, and special characters.

methods.name: anl_tweets
methods.description: Analyzes sentiment of a list of tweets and plots distribution.

methods.name: twitter_stream_listener
methods.description: Streams tweets containing specified keywords and saves to a CSV file.
